title: Understanding Bandwidth in KDE
text: The bandwidth in a KDE affects the smoothness of the curve. A smaller bandwidth results in a more jagged curve, while a larger bandwidth results in a smoother curve.

title: Identifying Small Bandwidth
text: Look for the KDE curve that appears the most jagged or has the most peaks. This indicates a smaller bandwidth.

hintAnswer: Curve A is somewhat jagged with multiple peaks.
title: Analyzing Curve A
text: Does Curve A appear smooth or jagged? How many peaks does it have?
choices: Curve A is somewhat jagged with multiple peaks.

hintAnswer: Curve D is very jagged with many peaks.
title: Analyzing Curve D
text: Does Curve D appear smooth or jagged? How many peaks does it have?
choices: Curve D is very jagged with many peaks.
